reviewer: agent visual review before video submission

checks.face: Same identity; natural pores, hair and cotton texture.
checks.hand: Full-frame and enlarged hand review: index and middle seated on mouse button areas, other fingers relaxed along side; no obvious extra fingers.
checks.mouse: Dark mouse distinct from pale desk; visible front silhouette, button seam and wheel; laptop does not occlude it.
checks.alignment: Relaxed wrist follows forearm and mouse grip without abrupt bend.
checks.gaze: Eyes directed toward laptop screen at frame right; not mouse.
checks.framing: Mouse and hand remain within x350 crop after scaling to1920x1080.

limits: Subjective sampled visual review; video motion requires separate review.
